hypothesis: A native 12H cloud reclaim following market-wide deleveraging may provide more upside than one while positions continue building.
single_variable: Only enter when a strict majority of the fixed twelve liquid Binance perpetuals experienced declining open contract quantity during the signal candle, as observed five minutes before its close. Compare with all cloud opportunities having the same coverage. Require exact native 5m observation clocks twelve hours apart, positive contract quantities and at least seven of the twelve usable symbols; ties do not satisfy a strict majority. Do not use changes in USDT open interest value, which depend on price. Apply the same rule to longs and shorts and to each control on its own clock.
data: Reuse the existing 12-symbol Binance daily metrics archive in exp-monday-1618-flow-20261023-v1 for 2022-09 through 2026-09-23. No newly downloaded open-interest series. This is a pilot of the observed date range, with independently funded 1000U wallets; it cannot prove 2020-2026 total wealth. The fixed large-asset panel was chosen for another study and is not a dynamic historical large-cap list.
account: Binance 680-contract observed archive, same NAV/10 9-slot efficient-trend exit and funding priority. Original fee classes at 5bp/2bp, prefunded 1x, no funding, exact-size liquidity or depth. Exclude expired entries and settle selected known contract-delivery paths using the official index-minute proxy. Show all results, including 2025 and 2026. Conditional checks for a development-pass improvement over equal-coverage baseline.
